name: Combination Lock Decoding
description: Combination locks can be defeated without picking by decoding — determining the combination through feel, measurement, or manipulation of internal contact points. Systematic decoders work through combinations by feel or measurement. Some locks have design weaknesses that allow the combination to be read with minimal effort. Many cheap combination padlocks protecting file rooms and storage areas can be decoded in under a minute, and even higher-quality dial locks have well-documented decoding procedures.

blue.det: Time spent at combination lock without opening; manipulation under tension may leave wear marks on dial.
blue.cm: High-security combination locks (Sergeant & Greenleaf, Sargent & Greenleaf); combination change policy; electronic access preferred over combination locks for security applications.
